annotations.text:
Cyan is measured — parsed out of 450 Kacky Reloaded maps and Deep Dip 1/2 with GBX.NET, with the sample size shown.
Amber is proposed or unverified — the route sections, and anything nothing in the toolchain can check.

The blueprint never mixes the two.

Open: sheet 1 is a flat, single-level road track. Kacky is a jump gauntlet built from platform blocks placed off-grid.

Sheet 2 is why that gap exists; sheet 3 is how far the palette reaches.
